description: This file contains service functions for managing chat messages, including creation, retrieval, deletion, and abort operations within a chat system. It interacts with database entities, external storage, and messaging queues.

methods.name: createChatMessage
methods.description: Creates a new chat message by calling a utility function and handles errors.

methods.name: getAllChatMessages
methods.description: Retrieves all chat messages for a given chat flow with optional filters and sorting.

methods.name: getAllInternalChatMessages
methods.description: Retrieves internal chat messages for a chat flow with optional filters.

methods.name: removeAllChatMessages
methods.description: Deletes all chat messages and related feedback and files for a specific chat ID and chat flow.

methods.name: removeChatMessagesByMessageIds
methods.description: Deletes specific chat messages by message IDs, including feedback, files, and executions.

methods.name: abortChatMessage
methods.description: Aborts an ongoing chat message operation, either via queue event or abort controller.

methods.name: getMessagesByChatflowIds
methods.description: Fetches chat messages associated with multiple chat flow IDs.

methods.name: getMessagesFeedbackByChatflowIds
methods.description: Fetches feedback for chat messages associated with multiple chat flow IDs.
